title: FLA binary import: AS2 className not decoded from CPicPage afterData
description: flash8-import.ts line 1260 writes className: meta?.className ?? '' but meta.className is always empty because flash8-binary.ts never decodes the className from the CPicPage afterData. For symbols with AS2 linkage (exportForActionScript=true), the className tells Flash which AS2 class to bind the symbol to at runtime (e.g. 'GameSprite'). CLAUDE.md notes: 'The className (AS2 class name) is NOT in the Contents stream; it likely lives in the Symbol N CPicPage afterData (not yet decoded).' Research the CPicPage afterData format for symbol className. Reference: flacomdoc CPicPage.java, eddiemoore/fla-decoder for the afterData schema. Decode and forward the className field.
